entries.zh: 地方；处所
entries.en: place; location
entries.notes: R 栏「geroc」不类官话对音，M 栏首节「Fe.」亦无可解，释义仅依 L 栏词头与 H 栏「處」定。

entries.zh: 境；地界、辖境（司法管辖所及的范围）
entries.en: territory; the bounds of a jurisdiction

entries.zh: 坛；土台（钉十字架之处）
entries.en: altar-platform; mound (the place of the Crucifixion)
entries.notes: H 栏字形介于「壇」「墳」之间，M 栏并见 hūn-mã（墳墓）一词，义界未定，故降中。

entries.zh: 位；尊位、地位
entries.en: position; seat of dignity, rank

entries.zh: 所；处所、所在（亦指村镇之地）
entries.en: place; locality, where something is (also of a town)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 此条原件已划除，H/M/R 三栏皆空；L 栏残义为「空气之处、空气之域、清凉」，无汉文与对音可据。

entries.zh: 卷轴；书写亡者名实以供丧仪之轴子
entries.en: scroll; the funeral scroll on which the dead's particulars are written
entries.notes: L 栏「lug[残]」为 lugar 之损文，M 栏 teg/tep 存疑；「軸」与「书亡者之事」尚可互证。

entries.zh: 代；替代、代他人之位
entries.en: in place of another; substitute

entries.zh: 空处；空缺之位（如宗座出缺之空位）
entries.en: empty place; a vacancy (as in a vacant see)

entries.zh: 下落；所在之处
entries.en: whereabouts; the place where someone or something is

entries.zh: 密处；隐蔽不为人见之处
entries.en: hidden place; secret spot

entries.zh: 陛下；君王所在、御前
entries.en: the King's presence; His Majesty
entries.notes: 「陛下」本指御阶之下，西语直解为「王之所在」，属敬称的字面化处理。

entries.zh: 会馆；聚会之所（同乡、行会议事之地）
entries.en: assembly hall; guild hall, place for meetings

entries.zh: 敝处；谦称自己的居处（卑微之地）
entries.en: my humble place (self-deprecatory term for one's own locality)
entries.notes: M 栏 pi/py 字形存疑，H「敝處」与 L「lugar bajo de poco valor」相合。

entries.zh: 山脉；宜作葬地之山（风水吉地）
entries.en: mountain range; hills fit for a grave site
entries.notes: L 栏「p̂」为 para 之省文；由「宜作葬地」推及「山脉」，系择葬风水语境，非字面直对。

entries.zh: 武场；武科考试之场
entries.en: martial examination ground (venue of the military examinations)

entries.zh: 教场；演武操练之场（生员习射之地）
entries.en: drill ground; training field where scholars practise
entries.notes: L 栏作「se exercitan los letrados」，与「教场」演武义略扞格，或指生员习射之所。

entries.zh: 科场；科举考试之场
entries.en: examination hall (for the civil examinations)

entries.zh: 贡院；乡试考场
entries.en: provincial examination compound (gongyuan)

entries.zh: 去处；所在之处（西语并注：大邑、一省之首府）
entries.en: place, whereabouts (with the added sense: a great town, the head of a province)
entries.notes: L 栏「cabeça de provincia」与「去處」字面不合，当为该条附列之义。

entries.zh: 泊船之处；聚泊众多船只的港湾
entries.en: anchorage; harbour where many vessels gather
entries.notes: 「掛澳」非习见词形，M 栏末字污损难辨，义依 L 栏与「澳」字定。

entries.zh: 清趣；清雅宜人的游憩之处
entries.en: a place of refined recreation; a clean, pleasant retreat
